from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """A company's diluted earnings per share from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as named in the report")
    diluted_eps: str | None = Field(description="The diluted earnings per share value as reported in the document")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this data, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    security_code: str | None = Field(description="The stock/security code if provided in the report")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_financial_metrics: list[CompanyFinancialMetric]
